exposure: Cesarean scar defect severity (severe vs. nonsevere)
Cesarean scar defect severity (residual myometrium ≤3-mm vs >3-mm)
cohort: 71 women with symptomatic cesarean scar defect (49 with severe defects and 22 with nonsevere defects)
finding: Hysteroscopic management of cesarean scar defects showed similar success rates and outcomes between women with severe and nonsevere defects, indicating its potential effectiveness regardless of defect severity.
